item.title: Workers who love 'synergizing paradigms' might be bad at their jobs
item.description:
📝 Those more receptive to corporate BS also scored significantly worse on a test of effective workplace decision-making. The study found that being more receptive to corporate bullshit was also positively linked to job satisfaction and feeling inspired by company mission statements. Moreover, those who were more likely to fall for corporate BS were also more likely to spread it.

item.title: US economy unexpectedly sheds 92,000 jobs in February
item.description:
📝 Employment in the federal government also continued to drop, shrinking by 10,000 last month. Since hitting a peak in October 2024, federal government employment has dropped by 330,000, or 11%, the Labor Department said. It also said job gains in December and January were lower than initially estimated.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjd98091g28o
